kpis.name: Battlecard usage
kpis.why: Shows reps trust and use the content
kpis.measure: Weekly views and opens from CRM and Slack, per rep
kpis.target: Majority of active AEs open a card each month

kpis.name: Win rate vs. each primary competitor
kpis.measure: Closed-won ÷ closed (won + lost) where the competitor is tagged in CRM
kpis.target: Baseline in days 61–90, then improve quarter over quarter

kpis.name: Time from competitor change to sales alert
kpis.why: Proves the Radar is fast enough to matter in live deals
kpis.measure: Source change detected → alert posted, for impact 4–5 signals

kpis.name: Deals with CI support
kpis.why: Coverage: how many competitive deals the program actually touches
kpis.measure: % of competitive opportunities with a battlecard view, alert, or SE consult
kpis.target: Track monthly; grow coverage each quarter

kpis.name: Comparison page conversion rate
kpis.why: Turns CI into pipeline from buyers already comparing
kpis.measure: Demo requests ÷ sessions on comparison pages
